Message: This template is missing a top-level Metadata.com.aws.cloudformation.Context block describing its architecture. Add top-level Metadata.com.aws.cloudformation.Context and set 'arch' to a concise summary of the template's high-level resource and data flow. Rule.Description: Flags a template whose top-level Metadata has no Metadata.com.aws.cloudformation.Context block, and significant resources missing a Metadata.com.aws.cloudformation.Context block. Incidental/framework resources and subordinate low-value types (e.g. AWS::Logs::LogGroup) are not required to carry context. Rationale written as YAML comments is not visible to cfn-lint; disable this rule (ignore_checks W4010) on templates that document context that way or do not adopt the Context convention.
Rule.ShortDescription: Template or significant resource has no Context block
